title: The Load-Bearing Lie
episode_goal: Maya must preserve evidence of structural fraud while preventing residents from entering a dangerous tower.
synopsis: Structural engineer Maya Chen is blamed at a televised hearing for approving the unsafe Harbor Heights tower, but she catches a revision code proving her calculations were replaced after her dismissal. She races to the occupied site, uncovers a failing transfer plate, and chooses to halt move-in despite the residents' financial risk and Adrian Vale's threatened retaliation. character_states.name: Maya Chen
character_states.motivation: Clear her name by proving developer fraud without putting occupied buildings at risk.

character_states.name: Adrian Vale
character_states.motivation: Open Harbor Heights on schedule and make Maya absorb the blame for its structural defects.

character_states.name: Luis Ortega
character_states.motivation: Keep his neighbors housed and alive while discovering who concealed the danger.

final_scene_outcome: She confirms City Hall's complicity but has sixty seconds to stop the evidence from being erased.
final_turning_point: The tablet reveals an official cover-up just as a remote deletion countdown begins.
next_episode_question: Can Maya retrieve the original inspection archive before Adrian erases it and turns the residents against her?
